title: FactBatchV3 — negotiated FactBatch payload when capability token target-attribution-v2 is present
description: CURRENT selected FactBatch payload iff Hello/HelloAck negotiated target-attribution-v2. FactCandidateV1 members are the historical closed candidate (opensip.fact-candidate.v1); occupancy is a PARALLEL companion array, not a FactCandidate field. When the token is absent, the historical FactBatchV2 payload (no occupancyCompanions, no schemaVersion) remains required. A V3 payload without the token, or a V2 payload with the token, is PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION. This is not a silent extension of FactBatchV2.

stageOrdinal.description: Joins retained execution-plan.stages[].ordinal of the Analyze stage that requested this output. Historical FactBatchV2.stageId is not this field and is not reinterpreted.

canonicalRelationPayloadHex.description: JSON-vector transcription of FactCandidateV1.canonicalRelationPayload bytes (fact-plane.v1). Not an additional wire field on CBOR transport. Host decodes once to the closed relation payload. Reference controls use canonical JSON UTF-8 bytes of the decoded payload as the transcription preimage.

candidates.description: Non-empty. Contiguous unique candidateOrdinal, nondecreasing. Unchanged FactCandidateV1 membership. No occupancy field. Order is admission-owned (integer ordinals; not utf-8 field-order).

occupancyCompanions.description: Zero or more OccupancyCompanionV1. Length MUST be <= candidates length. Every candidateOrdinal MUST name a candidate in this batch. Empty array is lawful (all occupancy unknown except exact-id ephemeral). Duplicate candidateOrdinal refuses. Extra ordinal refuses. Order is admission-owned by integer candidateOrdinal.

x-opensip-negotiation.whenPresent: FactBatch payload MUST admit as this schema
x-opensip-negotiation.whenAbsent: FactBatch payload MUST admit as historical FactBatchV2 (no schemaVersion, no occupancyCompanions). Occupancy unknown except exact-id ephemeral.
x-opensip-negotiation.helloLimits: No new ProtocolLimitsV3 member. occupancyCompanions bounded by existing maxFactBatchCandidates 4096 and by len(candidates).
x-opensip-negotiation.transitionTable: P3-23 ANALYZING FactBatch stays. Payload validation is prose-owned beside the 34 rows, as §9.2 already states for frame payloads.
